The Mohe and Khitan of the north.

She’s some great man’s precious daughter~~ so that’s why you married her~~

Why on earth live with a child like that~~
I swear!! I hate True Bones more than anything in this world…
So even Lord Pumsuk has it this hard…
And that girl of yours… has something like this too…?
*gulp*…

en: Loyal men of Goguryeo — hear the words of Yeon Gesomun!
In the south, Baekje and Silla covet us,
and in the west the Emperor comes this way, butchering nation after nation!
And all the while an incompetent king and rotten ministers shut their eyes to the world and lead this country down the road to ruin!!
Silla and Japan, then Baekje the next day, then the Tang!

lines: 하지만 백성들은 어떻소? 우리는 어디도 갈 데가 없습니다!
우리는 이 땅에서 살고, 죽고, 위져서 저들어올때 매일 번져 튼는 전 우리입니다!

We live on this land, we die on it, and we are the ones who bleed every time they come!

en: I don’t quite know either… perhaps he lost his nerve when he heard you were coming!
(Gesomun… a more fearsome man than I expected…)
…What? Kim Yushin is coming?
…Let him go.

lines: 내 말 못 들었나? 춘추를 놓아주라고.
아니 근데... 이 춘추라는 놈이 대체 누구길래 유신이가 직접 온다?
en: Did you not hear me? Release Chunchu.
But truly… who is this Chunchu, that Yushin comes for him himself?

blocks.html: Dosuryu asks Yeon about his decision.

lines: 아니, 유신이 대체 누구길래 대막리지께서 이렇게 구시오?
이 하늘 아래, 대막리지께서 두려워하는 자도 있었습니까?
en: Who is this Yushin, that the Supreme Commander behaves so?
Surely… you are not afraid?
Is there a man under heaven the Supreme Commander fears?

lines: 얘야, 아무리 죽을 각오를 한 자라도, 호랑이도 함부로 건드는 거 아니다.
우리도 언젠가 유신을 대적할 날이 오겠지...
하지만 춘추 같은거 가지고 이렇게까지 할 건 아냐.
en: Boy — even a man ready to die does not poke a tiger for no reason.
The day will come when we face Yushin…
but not over something like Chunchu.

blocks.html: News of Yeon’s Massacre reaches Baekje.
Euija (42), disguised, comes personally to Goguryeo. He requests a meeting with Yeon (37).

en: Have you come to see the king?
He does not grant an audience to just anyone.

blocks.html: Yeon is surprised that the new King of Baekje has come personally.

lines: 벽은 왕과 귀족세력을 싹 다 갈아엎어버렸다지요? 그거 하나만은 조금 부럽네...

en: Could you not do the same on your side?

lines: 나는 폭군으로 그 다음날 죽임 당할 거고, 아.
270년 전에, 이 평양성에서 백제가 우리 선왕을 시해한 건 개맹었소?
en: And 270 years ago, in this very Pyongyang — Baekje killed our late king. Have you forgotten?

lines: 아이고, 그러면 170년 전에 니네가 마루 선왕을 시해한 건 맞았나?
게다가... 우리 둘 사이에서, 고려왕을 시해 한 건 한 명 밖에 없고, 난 그거 확실히 아니구려.

blocks.html: Yeon threatens Euija.

lines: 네가 지금 이 칼로... 나제를 베어낸지 수 없는 이유를 대보라...!
en: Give me one reason I should not cut you down with this blade where you stand…!

lines: 개소문 자네... 군사는 통솔할 줄 알아도, 정치는 딱 봐도 초보구려. 정치는 뭔지 아나?
정치는, 연금술이야. 내가 하고 싶은 걸 위해 명분을 만들어내는, 연금술이라고.
자네... 지금 주변 나라 백성들 사이에서 자네를 선망하는 사람들 많은 거, 알고 있나?
탐관오리들을 싹 다 갈아엎어버리고, 새로운 시대를 가져올 자, 연개소문.
그런데... 지금 백제왕을 죽이면, 전부 나라롭에도 소문이 나겠지.
자네는 그냥 왕 시해하는 걸 좋아하는... 미친 도라이가 되는거야.
개소문... 때리고 부숴서 해결되지 않는 문제들도 있다는 걸 명심 잘 짓게나..:!

blocks.html: Yeon makes the same request

lines: 죽함 이북 땅이 원래 고구려의 영역이었는데 롤려주면 구원병을 보내주겠다.
en: The land north of the pass was Goguryeo’s. Return it, and I will send relief troops.

lines: 도대체 무슨 배짱으로 그의 앞에 온 건지 밝쳤네...!
en: What nerve, to come before him like that…!

lines: 이보세, 난 한 나라의 왕이야. 왕은, 사람이 아닐세.
죽게서도 확실히 해얍고, 외구에도 미리 밝네웁다.
나를 죽여봐야, 기껏 새로고 될친 더 화나것는 백제왕이 왕좌에 오르잖지.
신라는 무역톨로만 없어, 당나라, 천욱, 서역... 갈려면 이 항구 하나 밖에 없네.

blocks.html: Yeon warns Euija about Chunchu.

en: Do you know a <Kim Chunchu> of Silla?

lines: 그냥... 궁금해서. 자네를 별로 안 좋아하는 거 같구려.
자네를 없애닝고, 딱 주믈을 곧고 빌더라긋.
en: Just… curious. He does not seem to care for you much.
He spoke of being rid of you, hands folded in prayer.

lines: 춘추... 누군지는 모르겠지만, 그렇게 저장한 반면 놈은 쉬는 아닌 거 같은데.
남에게 무릎을 꿇는 자는 두렵지 않소이다.
의자와 백제를 멸하면, 내 오늘 죽어도 원한이 없겠습니다.
en: If Euija and Baekje are destroyed, I could die today without a grudge.

lines: 아니 자네, 신라 왕족이 고구려 장군한테 무릎 꿇어도 되는 건가?
원래 전투에서 패하고 나서야 이러는데... 나라 팔아먹는 행위구려.
en: Come now — should a royal of Silla kneel to a general of Goguryeo?
Men do this after losing a battle… this is selling your country.
I have no need of such things.
…What?
My family…
Gesomun… the world of politics is a new thing again…
What frightening men they are…!

blocks.html: In the meantime, Queen Sunduk sends Yushin to get revenge on Baekje.

en: I-i-it’s Kim Yushin!!
You’ve never heard of Kim Yushin…?

lines: 연개소문, 계백 장군 다 저리가라 그래
en: You fool — Kim Yushin is the first blade of Samhan…!
Yeon Gesomun, General Gyebek — tell them all to stand aside.
Kim Yushin is a general worth a hundred, you idiot!

blocks.html: Yushin conquers over 40 fortresses for Silla.
Yushin is greeted by the Three Goddesses, of the Forest (나림), Cavern (혈례), and Fire (골화).

en: Yushin, my friend~~
Well — is it enough now?
We have given Baekje a proper beating…
So then… do you mean to drag the King of Baekje back too?

lines: 이것 또한 이 시대의 흐름이 아닌가 하네요.
en: Brother… this is not only a private matter.
Of course I carry my own grudge,
but I wonder whether this is not also the current of the age.
It feels like a sign sent down from heaven.
Brother… I had little interest in any of it.
A wife I loved, a peaceful household.
I believed that much would be enough.
But the world—
Chunchu, what on earth are you saying…

lines: 우리가 젊은 시대였을 때 그 꿈을...
en: The eastern star shines especially bright tonight…
Brother… let us go and take it now.
That old palace of ours…
the dream we had when we were young…
The , I mean…!

lines: 계백아... 넌 어릴 적부터 왕궁에서 자랐다.
권력을 쥐하려다, 미쳐가는 사람을 수없이 봤다.
왕관을 쓴 노비도 있고, 길거리에서 구걸하는 임금도 있어.
en: Gyebek… you grew up in the palace from childhood.
You have seen countless men go mad reaching for power.
A man is one of two things — a king, or a slave.
There are slaves who wear crowns, and kings who beg in the street.
I have one request.
I will obey.

lines: 내가 몇 번 니한테 물몇된 명령을 해도.
너는 네가 판단하며, 너의 삶을 사내로써 살아라.
계백아, 너가 왕관을 쓰고 있지만, 기억해라.
en: No — do not follow me.
Even if I give you a foolish order more than once,
judge for yourself, and live your life as a man.
Gyebek — I may wear the crown, but remember:
you are the king of your own life too…!

lines: 페하... 이 애기를 저에게 왜 해주시는 겁니까?
en: Your Majesty… why are you telling me this?

lines: 계백아... 사람 됐냐 더 큰 꿈을.
en: Gyebek… a man should hold a larger dream.
The , I mean…!

lines: 솔직히 제가 이렇게 저는 왜 테아났나, 생각을 많이 해왔습니다.
마침내, 제 인생의 의가 처를 찾아야무섭습니다.
보통 사람들은, 그날 테마나서 삶다가 죽는다.
제 붉의 모든 빼가 부서질 때까지.
제 마음의 모든 구슬으 망가질 때까지.

blocks.html: 가이수뭰...?

The Emperor of the West resides in the Palace. 17 years ago, he murdered his brothers to become the Son of Heaven. Since then, he has conquered countless nations and subjugated them under imperial rule. The Turks. The Xueyantuo. The Tibetans.
He’s known by many names. The Heaven-Sent General. The Khan of Heaven.
Wei Zheng, the Grand Minister, is dying.

lines: 수나라의 실수를 다시 반복해서는 안 된다…!
en: The Great Tang is still a young dynasty.
We must not repeat the mistakes of the Sui…!
Not if the Chinese dream is to be realised.
The Chinese dream?

lines: 수나라가 통일했지만, 정신나간 양제 때문에 30년도 채 안 돼서 망했어.
en: The great revival of the Central Plain dynasties.
Han was the finest civilisation in the world.
And then—
Four hundred years. Four hundred years of being savaged by barbarians!!
Sui reunified it, then fell in less than thirty years because of that lunatic Emperor Yang.
And here I am. The Prince of Qin!

blocks.html: The Imperial Minister delivers the news.

lines: 천축에서는, 현장법사가 아직도 순례 중이라 합니다!
그런데 무슨 괴상한 이야기도 담더라고요, 날아다니는 원숭이라든동,
서역에서는, 새로운 제국이… 있습쉼? 이슬람? 이라는 새로운 가르침을 따른다고 합니다.
페르시아와 로마제국이 망했다고 하니, 막강한 세력인 듯 합니다.
en: From India — they say the monk Xuanzang is still on his pilgrimage!
Though he sends back the strangest tales — flying monkeys and the like,
and in the western regions a new empire… Islam? A new teaching they follow.
Persia and Rome are said to have fallen, so it must be a formidable power.
And in the east — the King of Goguryeo has been murdered by his own subject…
Wait.
Gai Suwen…?
The King of Goguryeo was a friend I valued.
His name… ah…
…Yeongnyu! King Yeongnyu!

blocks.html: The stage is set.

en: We have invaded six times already — and you would go again?
Because I have not gone myself.
Life is not theory. It is practice.

blocks.html: He launches the 7th Invasion of Goguryeo.
Emperor Yang of Sui invades Goguryeo in the year 612.
At the Battle of the Great River, the general Ulchi Munduk decisively defeats the Western Army.

lines: 神策究天文 신 책 구 천 문 — 그대의 귀신 같은 계책은 하늘의 이치천문을 다 헤아렸고
妙算窮地理 묘 산 궁 지 리 — 신묘한 계산은 땅의 이치지리를 통달했다
戰勝功旣高 전 승 공 기 고 — 전쟁에 이겨 쌓은 공이 이미 높으니
知足願云止 지 족 원 운 지 — 만족함을 알고 그치기를 바라노라

blocks.html: Munduk is honored with the title “The Defender” after the battle.
He requests help from Silla & Baekje, but only Silla sends troops. At the Tang defeats Goguryeo and sends shockwaves and fear across the nation.
At the ⚔ Battle of Ansi Fortress (645 AD), the Western Commander Yang Manchun successfully defends against the invasion.

lines: 영혼이 있는 사람들을 당신을 절대로 숭배 안해…!
나는, 역사상 최고의 황제로 남게될 것이다.

blocks.html: He requests help from Silla & Baekje, but only Silla sends troops. At the Tang defeats Goguryeo and sends shockwaves and fear across the nation. At the ⚔ Battle of Ansi Fortress (645 AD), the Western Commander Yang Manchun successfully defends against the invasion.

lines: 짐의 장수들이 늙었는데 마침 경을 얻었도다!
짐은 오늘 승리해서 기쁜 것이 아니라 용맹한 장수를 얻어 기쁘노라!

blocks.html: King Dongchun (#11) strikes the Yodong peninsula after a diplomatic spat.
The capital is sacked, and Goguryeo takes decades to recover.

Haemosu, the Son of Heaven, falls in love with Lady Yuhwa, the daughter of the river god Habek. However, Habek disapproves of the romance and expels his daughter. Yuhwa runs away, and is taken in by King Geumwa of Buyeo.
Yuhwa lays an egg, giving birth to a boy named Jumong. Jumong grows up with his brothers Daeso and Galsa — but his popularity and archery skills quickly make him a target for jealousy.

One night, Jumong narrowly escapes an assassination attempt. He whispers something to his wife, Lady Ye, before escaping the palace. His friends Oi, Mari, and Hyupbo join him and they run away with him into the mountains.

lines: 나는 황천(皇天)의 아들이며 어머니는 하백의 딸이신 추모 임금이다. 나를 위해 갈대를 엮고 자라를 띄워라!

blocks.html: He comes across some mountain tribes, and Yeon Tabal, one of the chieftains, welcomes him in. Jumong quickly becomes well-loved by the tribes, and falls in love with Yeon’s daughter Sosuno. Jumong leads the tribes in rebellion against the Han commanderies.
OO

lines: 아버지... 제 말을 듣기는 하시는 거예요?

blocks.html: Jumong spends the rest of his life fighting away the remaining Chinese commanderies, and expands Goguryeo.
Prince of Egypt
Jason and the Argonauts
The Guardian of Ansi Fortress is an eccentric man. After Yeon’s Massacre, he still refused to submit to Yeon and flies the old colors.
His name is not known. He’s simply referred to as the chief.

lines: 사내 대장부는, 아끼는 사람 한 명과, 섬기는 사람 한 명만 있으면 족하다고 들었습니다.
그날 이세민은, 인생 처음으로 패배와 후퇴를 겪었다.

en: You may outnumber us! You may outsmart us! But I can assure you of one thing, China…. You’ll never be crazier than us…!

blocks.html: After the battle, Yang Manchun is added to the Great Heroes of Goguryeo.

lines: 내가 천하의 군사를 가지고도 작은 오랑캐에게 곤욕을 당한 것은 무엇 때문인가?

blocks.html: Bidam (40) is selected by the Harmony Council to be the next High Councillor.
He expresses worry about Princess Seungman as the next queen.

en: Princess Seungman is not as clear-sighted as Her Majesty…
Hah… after the late king passed, a woman again.

lines: 고려의 개소문 한 명 만큼 훌륭한 사내가 없구려.
en: Our sacred country has produced no end of talent,
and yet not one man the equal of Goguryeo’s Gesomun.

lines: 설마 개소문처럼 역모를 생각은 하는 거야?
en: Bidam…! What are you saying?
Surely you are not thinking of treason, like Gesomun?

blocks.html: Bidam beings gathering forces to stage a coup.

en: The problem is these rotten ministers!

lines: 야, 임마. 무식한 소리 좀 고마해라.
백성이 총명했다면, 대신들도 눈치채고 일을 잘하겠지.
en: Oi. Enough of that ignorant talk.
The level of the ministers is the level of the country.
If the people were clear-sighted, the ministers would notice and do their jobs.
What are you talking about!
Do you look down on the people of this sacred country?
They have always—

lines: 아니, 이렇게까지 썩었는데 아무것도 안하고 누워있으면, 지도 어느 정도 책임을 져야지.
왜 항상 나라에서 제일 무식한 것들이 맨날 “내 나라 최고”라고 하는 걸까....
en: Yes. I look down on them. So what?
If everything is this rotten and you lie there doing nothing, some of the blame is yours.
Why is it always the most ignorant in a country who shout loudest that it is the greatest…

lines: 춘추 공께서 안 그러시겠다고 이미 들었습니다.
en: I have already heard that Lord Chunchu says he will not.

lines: 절대로, 한 순간 동안도 그 입에서 나오는 말을 믿으면 안돼...!
en: Chunchu is the most cunning man in Samhan…!
Never — not for one moment — believe a word that comes out of that mouth…!

blocks.html: Chunchu decides to travel to Japan, guided by his friend Takamuko no Kuromaro.
He is greeted by the King of Japan.

lines: 개소문 한 명 만큼 훌륭한 사내가 없구려.
en: Our sacred country has produced no end of talent,
and yet not one man the equal of Goguryeo’s Gesomun.

lines: 손자병법에 의하면, 최고의 전략은, 싸우지 않고 이기라는 거라고 했습니다.
이 춘추가 한마디만 더하자면, 결코 싸워야 한다면, 최고의 전략은 남의 손을 빌려서 싸우는 것입니다.
신라의 청년들이 벌써 너무 많이 숨졌습니다...!
제가 어떻게 그 부모들을 보고 체면을 서겠습니까?

blocks.html: He requests

lines: 춘추... 정녕 주변에 있는 모든 나라로 가서 구걸할 셈이냐?
신라가 옛날만큼 강국은 아니어도, 우리 스스로 백제와 고구려를 싸울 힘은 있다.

blocks.html: Queen Sunduk (52) is in critical condition.
High Councillor Bidam (42) and Yumjong gather forces in the Fortress of Radiance (명활성).
Bidam has secretly been gathering Nobles & soldiers to launch a rebellion against the aging Queen Sunduk.

lines: 화랑 비담!! 무기를 내려놓고, 폐하께 다시 충성을 바쳐라!!

blocks.html: Bidam and Yushin meet 1:1.

lines: 비담 공... 우리는 함께 인생에 맹세로 한 걸로 기억하는데...
너한테는 원래 나라가 없으니, 이 나라를 팔아먹는 것도 거슬리지 않겠지...
하지만 우리는 다르다. 우리는 이 땅에서 떼질 수 없는 관계야...
내 조상이 세운 나라를 황제한테 넘겨줄 셈이냐...!
너희는 뭐, 잘한 거 있어서 진골이 됐냐?
이거 가지라. 내 머리띠인데, 이걸 가지고 있으면 아무도 안 괴롭힐 거야.
지금 신국에 반기를 든 건 공이 아니잖소...!

blocks.html: Queen Sunduk (52) dies, comforted by Yushin.
Queen Jinduk (47) is officially coronated.

lines: 폐하의 마지막 순간까지... 같이 있겠다고 하지 않았습니까?
유신... 설마 비담이 한 말이 마음에 걸리는 건 아니겠지...?

blocks.html: Back to the flashback. there is a twist: the weak one was Yushin.

lines: 괜찮아요. 난 내가 스스로 이겨낼 거예요
제 이름은 김유신입니다! 신라의 위대한 장군이 될 거예요!!

blocks.html: This is the story of the Gaya confederacy.
The sky god Ibiga and mountain goddess Lady of the Right View give birth to two sons, King Suro and King Ijinasi.
On Earth, the people sing a song to call for a new king.

lines: 龜何龜何 구 하 구 하 거북아 거북아
首其現也 수 기 현 야 머리를 내어라
若不現也 약 불 현 야 내어놓지 않으면
燔灼而喫也 번 작 이 끽 야 구워서 먹으리

blocks.html: The people find a box of 6 eggs, and Suro and Ijinasi are among the babies to hatch from the eggs. They form 6 kingdoms:

The monk Shinsung and general Yomyo open the gates of the Fortress, letting the Tang army inside.

The story isn’t over yet.
The Emperor still controls large swaths of Samhan.
The final war begins...!
King Ugeo wants to fight until the end, but his prince Jang Hang is unsure.
The loyal official Sung Gi wants to keep fighting, but is assassinated by the traitors Noin, Choi, and Sam.
The gates are opened, the fortress is captured, and the Four Commanderies of Han are established. For hundredsd of years, the people of Joseon are ruled under an iron fist.
Before he dies, King Ugeo implores his people to survive and form new kingdoms.
The Emperor establishes the Eastern Commandery on Goguryeo land, causing anger.
